annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-vector realization of the scaling interval in equation (3.4a)

assumptions: The vector is nonempty and has positive infinity norm.
The scaling factor is nonnegative and satisfies the exact lower and upper inequalities in (3.4a).

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P20 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P20 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p20_t1_scaled_row_range {n : Nat} (x : Fin n -> Real) (lambda theta : Real) (hn : 0 < n) (hlambda : 0 <= lambda) (hnorm : 0 < p20InfNormVec x) (hlower : theta / (2 * p20InfNormVec x) < lambda) (hupper : lambda <= theta / p20InfNormVec x) : (forall i, abs (p20ScaleVec lambda x i) <= theta) and exists i, theta / 2 < abs (p20ScaleVec lambda x i)
formal_statement.plain_language: Under the row-scaling interval (3.4a), all scaled coefficients are at most theta and at least one is strictly larger than theta/2.

informal_proof: Use the coordinate bound by the finite infinity norm for the upper inequality and a coordinate attaining that norm for the strict lower inequality, then multiply the two source scaling inequalities by the positive norm.
informal_statement: The exact finite-vector maximum-coefficient consequence of the scaling interval (3.4a).
